label: r0a
issues: Tower is blocky and stepped rather than smoothly tapering; stripe bands are uneven and misaligned between faces
Lantern room is too small and the clear section barely reads as glazing; black gallery lacks the railing detail of the concept
Base is plain grey plates with only two curved slopes instead of the dark blue rocky outcrop
Exposed studs and a stray red stud on the tower wall break the clean painted-tower look
Overall proportions are narrow/tall compared with the concept's stout tower on a wide rock base
distilled: A chunky, stout LEGO lighthouse tower built from stacked bricks in alternating red and white bands, with small blue round tiles as windows and a rounded top cap holding a lantern room, mounted on a small rocky plate base.
